newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Saudi iron firm may borrow more for new plant.
newsitem.headline: Saudi iron firm may borrow more for new plant.

text.p: Saudi Iron and Steel Company Hadeed may increase to one billion riyals from 800 million a bank loan it is seeking to finance a new plant, bankers said on Tuesday.
"There is a possibility that Hadeed will increase the loan to one billion riyals," one banker said.
Saudi's Riyad Bank is leading a group of banks to arrange the long-term loan to finance the new steel plant for Hadeed, owned by industrial giant Saudi Basic Industries Corp.
It will be built in the Saudi industrial city of Jubail at a cost of 3.3 billion riyals.
Austria's Voest-Alpine industrieanlagenbau (VAI), a unit of VA Technologie AG, and Schloemann Siemag AG of Germany have won the contract to build the plant.
